exact_statement: For each integer d >= 3 and q >= 3, the nearest-neighbor ferromagnetic q-state Potts model on Z^d is conjectured to have positive spontaneous magnetization at its critical inverse temperature beta_c; equivalently, it is discontinuous in the source's definition.
assumptions: Nearest-neighbor ferromagnetic interaction; integer spin count q >= 3; dimension d >= 3; critical point defined through spontaneous magnetization.
source: H. Duminil-Copin, Lectures on the Ising and Potts models on the hypercubic lattice (2017), Conjecture 2 and definition of discontinuity, https://www.ihes.fr/~/duminil/publi/2017PIMS.pdf, PDF pp. 5,93
source_quote: Conjecture 2 Prove that the phase transition of the nearest-neighbor Potts model on Z^d (with d >= 3) is discontinuous for any q >= 3.
proof_or_counterexample: Source statement checked against primary PDF; conjecture has no proof in source.
remaining_gap: Prove positive critical magnetization in the unresolved finite-q, finite-d regime; current openness as of 2026 remains unverified.

exact_statement: For any nonempty finite free-boundary zero-field q-state Potts graph, q integer >=2, beta>=0, the favored-color centered pressure has P''=a2 E[S2]/N, P'''=a3 E[S3]/N, and P''''=(a4 E[S4]+3a2^2 Var(S2))/N at field zero.
assumptions: Free boundary; finite graph; uniform independent colors conditional on FK components; a2=(q-1)/q^2, a3=(q-1)(q-2)/q^3, a4=(q-1)(q^2-6q+6)/q^4.
proof_or_counterexample: Independently expanded conditional moments and subtracted 3(E X^2)^2; exact q=3 two-vertex enumeration gave cumulants 5/9,7/27,-8/27 on both spin and FK sides (before division by N).
remaining_gap: Finite-volume identity gives no uniform thermodynamic remainder or critical magnetization.

exact_statement: The local finite-volume Legendre cubic is -B/(6A^3), and a C1 remainder bounded by C m^4 together with b_t>=b>0 excludes a stationary point F(m)<=F(0) for 0<m<min(r0,b/(6C)); if C=0 every such interior point is excluded.
assumptions: A=P''(0)>0, B=P'''(0); for exclusion F=a m^2-b_t m^3+R on [0,r0], |R|<=C m^4, |R'|<=4C m^3.
proof_or_counterexample: Inverse-function differentiation gives I'''(0)=-B/A^3. Substitution gives F(m)>=b m^3/2-3C m^4. Checked C=0 separately and strict endpoint; no claim at m=b/(6C).
remaining_gap: The actual lattice Potts constrained potential is not shown to satisfy the uniform assumptions.

exact_statement: If the uniform actual-Potts potential hypothesis SP(q,d) in w456 L5 holds for all beta just above beta_c, then M(beta_c)>=eta>0; SP itself remains unproved.
assumptions: Fixed integers q,d>=3; q>=1 FK boundary and parameter monotonicity; fixed r0,b,C and physical stationarity/minimum link across beta in (beta_c,beta_c+delta).
source_quote: This is the single unresolved input SP(q,d); it is not renamed a proof of C0048.
proof_or_counterexample: L4 yields M(beta)>=eta uniformly. Finite-box wired magnetizations decrease with volume and are continuous in beta, so their infimum is upper semicontinuous; parameter monotonicity then gives right continuity at beta_c.
remaining_gap: Prove SP(q,d) for actual nearest-neighbor model, especially q=d=3; no proof of parent target.

exact_statement: For finite FK with q>=1, p in (0,1), each edge conditional open probability given all other edges is either p or a=p/(p+q(1-p)); every fixed simple n-edge path has open probability in [a^n,p^n]. Positive local conditional probabilities alone do not imply infinite-cluster probability.
assumptions: Finite graph with arbitrary fixed FK boundary partition; chain rule for path; in the example Z^3, q=3,p=1/10.
source_quote: a^n <= P(all n path edges open) <= p^n.
proof_or_counterexample: Edge-weight ratio gives p or a. Tower property preserves bounds under partial exposure. Union over at most 2d(2d-1)^(N-1) paths gives f_N<=0.6(0.5)^(N-1) in the example. Exact C4 enumeration gives Z=258, marginal=11/43, all-open=1/86, ratio to product 2.71521754.
remaining_gap: Subcritical example does not address the critical q=3,d=3 case.

exact_statement: For wired FK on Z^d with q>=1, theta_w(p)=inf_N phi^w_{Lambda_N,p,q}(0 connected to boundary Lambda_N) is right continuous. A fixed positive lower bound on theta_w(p) for all p just above p_c therefore implies theta_w(p_c)>0.
assumptions: Standard finite-volume wired FK domain Markov comparison; p in (0,1); finite boxes increasing to Z^d.
source_quote: The same delta must survive the p-downarrow-p_c and N-to-infinity limits.
proof_or_counterexample: Finite-box f_N decrease in N and increase continuously in p. Infimum of f_N is upper semicontinuous; monotonicity gives right continuity. Inner-boundary event sandwiches the limiting f_N against infinite-volume theta_w.
remaining_gap: No uniform positive critical-window bound has been proved.

exact_statement: An S3-invariant scalar functional can have a fixed nonzero cubic term and still develop a continuous ordered minimizer if a nonanalytic r^(5/2) term dominates the cubic near zero.
assumptions: Functional F_t(z)=-t|z|^2+|z|^(5/2)-Re(z^3)+|z|^4 on C; this is an abstract functional, not a Potts lattice Gibbs potential.
proof_or_counterexample: With s=sqrt(r), 1-s+s^3>=1-2/(3sqrt(3))=:c>0, so t<=0 has unique zero minimizer and each t>0 minimizer has radius <=(t/c)^2, tending to zero.
remaining_gap: Does not decide C0048; it blocks an argument from cubic symmetry alone.
